AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agri- business Accounts? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agri- business Accounts.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agri- business Accounts.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Agri- business Accounts.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agri- business Accounts.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Breeding? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Breeding.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Breeding.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Breeding.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Breeding.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Nutrition.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Nutrition.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Nutrition.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Nutrition.

4. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Health: Disease Control? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Health: Disease Control.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Health: Disease Control.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Health: Disease Control.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Disease Control.

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

8. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agricultural Biotechnology? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agricultural Biotechnology.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agricultural Biotechnology.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agricultural Biotechnology.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Agricultural Biotechnology.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil Erosion Control? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Soil Erosion Control.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil Erosion Control.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil Erosion Control.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Erosion Control.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ornamental Cropping? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Ornamental Cropping.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ornamental Cropping.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ornamental Cropping.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Cropping.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Livestock Nutrition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Breeding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Health: Disease Control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agri- business Accounts.

2. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Breeding.

3. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Nutrition.

4. D — Producers

5. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Disease Control.

6. C — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

7. A — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

8. B — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

9. A — newton (N)

10. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agricultural Biotechnology.

11. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Erosion Control.

12. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Cropping.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Livestock Nutrition; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Animal Health: Disease Control; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
